verdict.rationale: INPI's own site publishes a 'Guia de pedido online de marcas e logótipos' (guide to online trademark and logo applications), so the core filing transaction can be done online. Its pages also say rights holders can request issuance of the title certificate online. The many service pages describe filing patents, utility models, designs and trademark actions, but most do not explicitly say those steps are completed online. Missing for 10: explicit statement that patent/design filings are online, documented online fee payment, step-by-step detail of the online filing flow, independent or hands-on corroboration.
